title: Fig Watches a Seed
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new sounds wh, ph
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness), 86-sound stage (wh, ph just added).

pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting beside a large plant pot in the vegetable patch.

pages.text: Fig pops a seed in the pot.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar dropping a small seed into the soil of the pot.
The plant pot sitting quietly in the sunshine, nothing yet visible above the soil.
A cut-away view beneath the soil showing a thin root growing downward.
A tiny green shoot poking up out of the soil in the pot.
The green shoot grown taller, standing straight up from the pot.
Fig the caterpillar noticing a new green leaf unfurling on the growing plant.
Fig the caterpillar spotting a small bud forming near the top of the plant.

pages.text: Fig is glad. What a big plant!
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar looking up at the tall, leafy plant with delight.
Fig the caterpillar sitting beside the fully grown plant, looking proud of it.
